screenshots.name: desktop-pending-calculation.png
screenshots.findings: The optional calculation checkbox and correctly checked half prediction are visible. The labeled blank W entry and Check calculation action fit; worked equations and comparison bars are absent, and the prompt explains how to reveal them.

screenshots.name: desktop-checked-calculation.png
screenshots.findings: The entered 25 W value is correctly checked beside the selected half prediction. The 50 W to 25 W equation, shared-scale solid/striped bars and aligned cards are readable; the new calculation section and controls fit without clipping.

screenshots.name: dark-phone-energy-calculation.png
screenshots.findings: At a 320-pixel dark viewport, the complete Time to input energy selector, checked same prediction and labeled 250 J entry fit. The 30 s to 60 s scenario, same-energy equation and equal bars stack cleanly, with readable feedback and wrapped actions.

screenshots.name: forced-colors-phone-load-calculation.png
screenshots.findings: At a 320-pixel forced-colors viewport, the 5000 N to 2500 N scenario, selected half prediction and 312.5 W entry are clear. System-colored checkbox, radios, input, focus and borders remain distinguishable; the 625 W and 312.5 W bars retain solid/striped contrast and fit the panel.

limitations: Native React/THREE with local Chromium software WebGL; no deployed host build exercised.
Forced colors is browser emulation; no physical assistive technology session.
